verdict.rationale: Authy is a consumer authenticator app; there is no documented CLI/API for a user or agent to programmatically fetch their own current TOTP code, and Twilio's docs confirm the Authy API is deprecated and closed to new customers with no successor for this use case. Community evidence further shows Authy intentionally blocks exporting secrets/codes, requiring hacky workarounds (deprecated Chrome extension, debug-mode Electron hacks) rather than any supported programmatic access.
